QUOTE: Those pointers start at `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_STD_CALLOC` / `STD_FREE`, which default to libc (`platform.h:84,87`).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the runtime pointers default to libc calloc/free, the opposite of the item's claim that uninitialised pointers fail (calloc returns NULL, free does nothing); the only nearby text is a hedge about NO_STD_FUNCTIONS stubs returning NULL, which doesn't state the mechanism.
